svg.title: Pseudounipolar Sensory Neuron — Schematic
svg.desc: Original pseudounipolar morphology with the soma outside the through-path, attached by one stem to a continuous T-junction. The two lateral branches are axonal; no transport direction, regenerative state or measured caliber is asserted.
